source: Alps RK09K single-gang potentiometer datasheet (generalize/plan.json datasheet_note): body 9.5 mm, M7 x 0.75 bushing 7 mm, 6 mm D-shaft, 15 mm shaft length. ASSUMED: body is 9.5 x 9.5 mm in plan (the sheet gives only 9.5) and 6.0 mm tall above the PCB; 3 terminals at 5.0 mm pitch along one edge, 2.5 mm beyond the body side.
frame: panel control: origin at the body min corner, body bottom (PCB seat) at Z = 0, bushing and shaft toward +Z, pins toward -Z; shaft axis at the body centre in X, at shaft_y in Y

body_width.source: ASSUMED: body Y taken equal to 9.5; +/- 1.5 (real RK09K body is up to ~12 mm deep with its terminal lip)

body_height.source: ASSUMED body height above the PCB; +/- 1.0

shaft_y.source: shaft axis Y; ASSUMED at the body centre; +/- 0.5

shaft_length.source: datasheet: shaft length from the bushing face

max_panel_thickness.source: ASSUMED panel limit: thread length minus a 3 mm-thick nut; +/- 1.0

nut_diameter.source: ASSUMED M7 hex nut across corners (8 mm AF, 9.2 min; 11 with washer); +/- 1.0

knob_clearance.source: ASSUMED minimum gap from the knob skirt to the panel; request/rules may override

pin_pitch.source: ASSUMED terminal pitch (RK09K 5 mm; some variants 2.5); +/- 2.5, measure

pin_y_offset.source: ASSUMED terminal row offset from the shaft axis (toward -Y beyond the body edge); +/- 1.0

pin_length.source: ASSUMED terminal length below the body

mount.notes: panel hole = bushing diameter plus rules clearance (M7 x 0.75 thread); panel plane lies below BUSHING_TOP by the panel thickness; the knob sits on SHAFT_AXIS above the panel

notes: Same panel-mount convention as encoder_ec11: M7 hole, D-shaft knob, shaft tip 15 mm above BUSHING_TOP. Designed contact: bushing seat on the panel. ASSUMPTIONS and uncertainty: the plan gives only 'body 9.5 mm', so the plan view is a 9.5 x 9.5 square (the true body is deeper, +/-1.5 mm Y; the footprint reserve should be grown on measuring); body height 6.0 (+/-1.0); terminal pitch 5.0 (+/-2.5: some RK09 variants use 2.5 mm), 3 terminals on the -Y edge outside the body; shaft D flat 4.5 across flats (+/-0.2); max_panel_thickness 3.0 (+/-1.0). Import gate: body bounding box 9.5 x 9.5 x 6.0; shaft axis +Z; shaft 15 above the bushing top.

self_checks.name: bushing long enough for panel and nut
